points.quote: `defineBlockSchema({flavour, props, metadata, toModel})` ... `flavour` is the namespaced id, such as `'affine:paragraph'`. ... `metadata` holds `version`, `role` (such as `'content'`)
`metadata` holds `version`, `role` (such as `'content'`) and the allowed `parent` flavours.
The model is a class extending `BlockModel<Props>`, for example `ParagraphBlockModel`. ... `toModel: () => new ParagraphBlockModel()` creates the model.

The component extends `BlockComponent<Model>` ... Children go through `this.std.host.renderChildren(model)` ... `BlockViewExtension('affine:paragraph', literal`affine-paragraph`)`, which maps the flavour to the tag name
Each block package exports two extension providers ... `StoreExtensionProvider` ... `ViewExtensionProvider` ... `StoreExtensionManager` and `ViewExtensionManager` ... collect the providers.
Its `effect()` calls `effects()` to define the custom elements.
